placements.why: Both expressions ratify and define the organizational and architectural contract governing asynchronous remember jobs, receipt returns, and decoupled consumption paths.
placements.title: Asynchronous job contracts for non-blocking execution and result consumption
placements.frame: How are asynchronous job interfaces and execution protocols structured to govern dispatch, cursor polling, and result handling?

placements.title: Async job contracts guarantee immediate receipts while decoupling execution tracking from blocking calls
placements.frame: How does the asynchronous execution contract guarantee immediate non-blocking receipts, eliminate lost work upon client drop, and enable flexible cursor polling or piggybacked consumption?
placements.why: src-1 articulates the ratified async job contract where remember yields an immediate receipt and cursor polling eliminates blocking and lost work; src-2 defines the complementary dispatch mechanism allowing clients to either poll or consume piggybacked reactions on subsequent calls.
